host_output_cap.reserved_envelope_rationale: The envelope carries the payload as an escaped JSON string, so its cost scales with the payload and reached 621 tokens on the real corpus. The previous 450 was measured when payloads were 44 tokens and could not surface the shortfall.

surfaces.limitation: Codex does not invoke the local function-tool hook path.
Specialized tool paths may opt out of the default hook path.

modes.off: No event decoding, capture, evaluation, or replacement.
modes.observe: Capture and evaluate supported events without replacing the original result.
modes.active: Replace supported over-budget results with bounded projection feedback; never label a failed projection as success.

preservation.derivation: shape-detected from a bounded prefix of the observation

distributing_shapes.unified-diff/v1: ranks lines within their hunk so selection spreads across every hunk instead of filling the first ones

focus.derived_from: session intent recorded by UserPromptSubmit, and tool_input only when the session recorded none

session_record.location: a private directory beside the artifact store
session_record.name: sha256 of the session identifier
session_record.content_class: untrusted inert text, bounded to max_bytes, never logged

measured_retention.note: Measured after the unified-diff distribution fix. The v3 qualification measured 25, 17 and 13 before it.

UserPromptSubmit.role: carries the intent the observation is read for; records a session focus and returns no model-visible output
UserPromptSubmit.failure_behavior: a store that cannot hold the record leaves the request on its tool-input focus
